n: PortaPow Premium USB + DC Power Monitor

cs.t: +1. This is a great and powerful USB power meter which is highly recommended. Make sure that you read and keep the manual handy since there are so many functions (and heed the warnings listed there). There are other cheaper versions/clones of this on Aliexpress which may also be good. Another great gadget (no USB-C though) is "PortaPow Premium USB + DC Power Monitor/Multimeter/DC Ammeter" which is a neat little device -  https://lygte-info.dk/review/USBmeter%20Portapow%20UK.html  Checkout the reviews on Amazon too for further details.
cs.th: They make USB-C cables with displays now
